name: Ngaio Marsh
role: New Zealand crime writer and theatre director
legacy: As a crime writer during the "Golden Age of Detective Fiction", this person is known as one of the "Queens of Crime", along with Agatha Christie, Dorothy L. Sayers, and Margery Allingham

checks.lead: Dame Edith Ngaio Marsh ( NY-oh; 23 April 1895 – 18 February 1982) was a New Zealand writer.
